entries.back_en: Bahahaha!_300_ Mine, mine... How tragic! You died before you could even set off! What an end for the 'unbeatable' Sword of Zarga.
entries.note: 'My, my' e interjeicao; 'Meu, meu' e traducao literal incorreta. Use 'Ora, ora'.

entries.back_en: As far as I know, until those Valkyries appeared, no. But since you're here, I doubt it'll last much longer._100_ Unfortunately for me, I won't see the fall of Zarga with my own eyes...
That damned friend of yours gifted me an arrow in the back...
Wait._100_ Those bodies..._500_ You aren't dead?!
Brigard... It's a war... If she hasn't arrived yet, she soon will.
